credit: つくよみちゃんコーパス（CV.夢前黎） https://tyc.rei-yumesaki.net/material/corpus/
source_version: dialogues-v1 (sha256 in reports/m3-script-validation.json) + tsukuyomi-corpus-v1 train split + m3/ref/speakerB.wav
role: V0. Channel A is the tsukuyomi corpus recording itself; channel B is the frozen synthetic speaker.

terms.training_use: Permitted: the corpus terms allow use for any purpose including commercial model training.
terms.redistribution: The corpus itself may not be redistributed, and this dataset embeds its audio, so neither may this.
terms.credit_on_publication: 本ソフトウェアの音声合成には、フリー素材キャラクター「つくよみちゃん」が無料公開している音声データを使用しています。

notes: Speaker B is the same frozen wav in both datasets, byte for byte, so the two differ only in channel A.
Only the corpus TRAIN split is used. The 10 dev and 10 test sentences never enter either dataset, because condition 4 is measured on held-out audio.
The 72/8 split comes from m3/scripts/split-map-v1.json and is shared by both datasets, so the comparison stays paired.
Audio is gitignored. The scripts, split map, manifest and reports are committed.

Channel A carries 8.67 minutes across 80 sentences - 4.6% of the 189.9 minutes the past amitaro experiment used. A null result on condition 4 is ambiguous between method and quantity; reports/m3-dataset-agreement.json and the M3 plan both say so.
